name: How should I prepare my home before kitchen cabinet replacement begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before kitchen cabinet replacement begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before cabinet installers arrive, clear out all items from your existing cabinets and countertops, packing dishes and cookware into labeled boxes. You should also create a clear path from your entry door to the kitchen so the crew can transport bulky cabinet boxes and tools without damaging walls or trim. Plan for a temporary cooking station in an adjacent room, as your sink, stove, and counters will be unavailable during the removal and rough-in stages of the remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Empty all cabinets and countertops, clear a walkway for the crew to move materials, and set up a temporary cooking area away from the kitchen workspace.
